name: Luther Keith Wilkins

items.why: The item says the records searched (FARA filings, foreign-government payments, state-owned business, foreign-agent donors) showed nothing, so there is no conduct by this person bearing on the foreign-ties criterion.

for_review: The item is a null finding, and I found nothing to contradict it. I did not open the FARA database or the campaign-finance filings myself. The single search on the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) with his name returned nothing from any of them. The record shows Wilkins is a challenger, not a sitting State Representative. He lost to Michael Owen in 2024 and was running against him again in 2026. County results on Nov 3, 2026 showed Owen ahead, about 61% to 39%. The Ballot Buddy header should be checked. His career is a mix of insurance sales, logistics work, Army service and a newspaper publisher role, which matters for the real-work criterion. I did not weigh it here.
